In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly stated that "Schiavone was runner-up in singles at the 2011 Wimbledon" based on the text from the Wikipedia page. However, the visible text in the screenshot explicitly states: "Schiavone was also runner-up in singles at the 2011 French Open and in women's doubles at the 2008 French Open." The Planner misread "French Open" as "Wimbledon," which led to the incorrect conclusion that the overlap between Schiavone and Morozova was Wimbledon (since Morozova was a 1974 Wimbledon finalist). This error caused the entire subsequent reasoning path to focus on Wimbledon instead of the correct answer, the French Open.
